_comment: Dashboard config. Rewritten by the Zero-angles button and the one-shot controls; hand-edit gear_ratio / label / sign / leg here.

leg._comment: ODRI module v1.1: 9:1 belt, 160 mm segments. Press 'Zero angles' with the leg FOLDED: hip=0 knee=0 there, rising to hip=90 knee=180 fully extended. The knee reading is the included angle between the links, so hip height above the floor = 2*segment_mm*sin(knee/2) + foot_offset_mm. foot_offset_mm is the cylinder on the foot. knee_offset_deg is 0 because the links fold flat (they run in parallel planes). joints[0] is the ROOT.
